name: Paneer Patiala
steps: Heat 15 ml oil and sauté half the onions with capsicum and peas for 5 minutes. Add half the crumbled paneer, a pinch of salt and half the garam masala; cook 2 minutes and cool the filling.
Briefly dip each papad in water until pliable, then pat dry. Place a quarter of the filling on each, roll firmly, and shallow-fry in 15 ml oil until set and lightly golden. Cut the rolls in half.
For the gravy, heat remaining oil and cook remaining onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, coriander and chili; stir 1 minute. Add tomato puree and 5 g salt, and cook 10 minutes until thick.
Add water and simmer the gravy 5 minutes. Stir in remaining crumbled paneer and cream, then season with remaining salt and garam masala. Keep the sauce thick enough to cradle the rolls.
Arrange papad-paneer rolls in a shallow serving bowl and spoon hot gravy around them just before serving. Leave the roll tops visible so their delicate wrappers retain some texture.
tips: Fill softened papads promptly and add gravy at serving time, or the rolls become soggy.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
